p1791467634.title: Testing Automation After Bug Fix
p1791467634.content:
This is a test post to verify that the state save bug is fixed.

The new workflow now:
- Purges duplicate pending entries
- Cleans stale pending on startup
- Uses git pull --rebase to avoid conflicts
- Warns if image upload fails

- Bold text works
- *Italic text works*
- [Link support](https://hiarif.com)

Let's see if this publishes cleanly.
